slides.title: Things I wish I knew before trying to organize with ADHD
Visible beats pretty
slides.body: Closed matching bins look great and hide everything forever. Clear bins and open shelves work better for us.

slides.title: Store things where they land
slides.body: Shoes pile by the couch? Put a basket by the couch. Work with your habits, not against them.

slides.title: Fewer steps wins
slides.body: Every step (open door, lift lid, unzip) cuts the chance it gets put away. Aim for one step.

slides.title: Owning less is the real system
slides.body: No organizing system can hold more stuff than you have space for. Less stuff means less to organize.

slides.title: Organizing is not cleaning
slides.body: Organizing is setting up homes. Cleaning is using them. Do the first once and the second gets easier.

slides.title: A routine can be tiny
slides.body: The best routine is the one you do on a bad day. Build for your worst day, not your best.

slides.title: Build your home for your worst day, not your best one.
The whole shame-free system
slides.body: All of this and a 7-day plan to set it up is in The Messy Brain Home Reset. Link in bio.
